title: New Home Builder Warranties — Benefit Limits for Systems Extension, Appliance and Emergency Claims
content:
This schedule of benefit limits gives, program by program across Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, the dollar figures and covered lists for three kinds of claim payment: systems claims in the extension years, appliance claims, and reimbursement of emergency work the homeowner had done to stop further damage.

## Systems extension years

The extension years are the years in which Bridgewell insures distribution systems beyond year two after the closing date.

| Program | Deductible per systems claim | Limit per systems claim | Total limit for systems claims in the extension years | Trades covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 100.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 7500.00 USD | plumbing, electrical, HVAC |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 100.00 USD | 3500.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | plumbing, electrical, HVAC |

## Builder-installed appliances

| Program | Limit per appliance claim | Service fee per appliance claim | Appliance types covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 1500.00 USD | 75.00 USD | refrigerator, range, dishwasher, built-in microwave, garbage disposal |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | none |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 2000.00 USD | 75.00 USD | refrigerator, range, dishwasher, built-in microwave, garbage disposal, clothes washer, clothes dryer |

## Emergency work

| Program | Amount reimbursed for emergency work done to prevent further damage before a claim is evaluated |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 1000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 1000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 1000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 1000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 1000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 2500.00 USD |

## Points of comparison

**Which programs list covered extension trades?** Only the Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension and the Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty; both list plumbing, electrical and HVAC, and they differ in the per-claim limit (2500.00 against 3500.00 USD) and the total limit (7500.00 against 10000.00 USD).

**Which programs list covered appliance types?** Only the Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances, with five types, and the Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty, which adds the clothes washer and the clothes dryer to those five.
